name: SPECTRUM SBS560CHT 40V Cordless Hedge Trimmer, 45cm Laser-Cut Blade, Brushless Motor, 2,600 Cuts/Min, 18mm Capacity, 90 Rotating
Body Copy:
Trim 45cm of hedge in a single sweep with the Spectrum SBS560CHT, a 40V cordless hedge trimmer built around a brushless motor and laser-cut blade. The brushless drive runs cooler, draws less from each charge, and outlasts brush-motor rivals between services. At 2,600 cuts per minute the blade keeps moving through dense foliage, while the 18mm cutting capacity bites into the woodier growth older hedges throw up.

Weight sits at 2.91kg, so holding the trimmer overhead for face cuts stays manageable over a longer session. The rotating handle pivots through 90 degrees so you can switch from horizontal top cuts to vertical face cuts without changing your stance or grip. This is a bare-tool model, compatible with every Spectrum 40V battery and charger sold separately, and backed by the Spectrum 5-year warranty.
Unique Selling Point 01: Brushless motor stays cooler and extracts more runtime per charge
Unique Selling Point 02: 2,600 cuts per minute for fast trimming in fewer passes
Unique Selling Point 03: 45cm laser-cut blade with 18mm cutting capacity for established hedges
Unique Selling Point 04: Rotating handle pivots 90 degrees for vertical face cuts
Unique Selling Point 05: 2.91kg light enough to hold overhead for longer sessions
Unique Selling Point 06: Shares batteries with every Spectrum 40V cordless garden tool
Selling Copy: Cordless 40V hedge trimmer from the Spectrum garden lineup. Brushless motor, 45cm laser-cut blade, 18mm cutting capacity and a 90 degree rotating handle. At 2.91kg it sits light enough to hold overhead. Bare tool, takes any Spectrum 40V battery and charger sold separately.
Tech_Included: Cordless hedge trimmer only (battery and charger sold separately)
